Last week, Apple kicked off a new beta testing cycle for its 27.2 series software, and just five days later, the company has now pushed out beta 2 for iPadOS 27.2 and several other systems.

iPadOS 27.2 beta 2 update rolls out, with tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2 and more arriving simultaneously

For Apple, this week has been a particularly busy one.

The company officially rolled out major updates including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate to the public last Monday. Just a few days later, developer beta 1 of the 27.2 series made its appearance.

It is surprising that 27.1 is being skipped, but according to reports, this update will be exclusive to the iPhone Duo.

So Apple is bringing 27.2 directly to beta testers, and the key new features in iPadOS 27.2 and other systems include:

  • Apple TV's Profiles feature lands on iPhone and iPad
  • A completely redesigned and upgraded Health app
  • Siri AI expands language support
  • iPad gains a Siri feature previously exclusive to Mac

And today, beta 2 of multiple systems including iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, and tvOS 27.2 are rolling out simultaneously.

Just five days after beta 1, today's version is unlikely to bring many major changes, and will instead focus on bug fixes and performance improvements, and may add some smaller new features.

Have you installed the iPadOS 27.2 or beta 2 of other systems? Feel free to share any new discoveries you've made in the user comment section.
